svg.title: BERT · bidirectional encoder
svg.desc: Original conceptual schematic. Encoder-only bidirectional Transformer; token/segment/position embeddings; CLS sequence head and masked-language-model token head. Not a reproduction of a paper figure. MIT.

g.text: Token, segment and position embeddings feed encoder-only Transformer blocks
Left and right context are visible at every encoder layer.
